definition: Training a student on reasoning traces rather than on answers alone, and across 4 sources a practice whose benefit the archive can now locate fairly precisely: out of distribution rather than in it. The controlled study is the anchor -- the two conditions differ in nothing but the training target, and rationales buy nothing in-domain for strong backbones while buying 20 to 28 points on a contamination-audited external benchmark, with a two-annotator human study attributing the measurable effect to language adherence and inspectability rather than to better reasoning. A domain-specific instance agrees on direction and magnitude: chain-of-thought supervision lifts a 9B model to 89.0 percent micro accuracy where answer-only supervision reaches 75.1 and the base model 37.4. Two refinements. The trace must match the student's capacity, which one source implements by having a teacher decompose and prune the student's own reasoning by skill before distilling it back. And the gain is largest for the weakest backbone and smallest for one already tuned for the domain, which is the same capacity-and-idiom pattern the archive's distillation entries record.

evidence.note: Compares chain-of-thought against answer-only supervision under a protocol where the two conditions differ in nothing but the training target, and finds the rationales buy nothing in-domain for strong backbones while buying 20 to 28 points out of domain -- with a human study attributing the measurable effect to language adherence and inspectability rather than to better reasoning.
evidence.title: MathShikkha: A Controlled Study of Answer-Only and Chain-of-Thought Supervision for Bangla Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models

evidence.note: Builds an industrial-safety reasoning benchmark from two pipelines -- program execution over safety scene graphs, and evidence graphs extracted from real accident-investigation reports -- and shows that general multimodal capability does not transfer to it while a 9B model fine-tuned on its chain-of-thought split matches frontier systems.
evidence.title: SafeSceneReason: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Connecting Industrial Hazards with Accident Knowledge

evidence.note: Has a teacher decompose and prune a student's reasoning by mathematical skill, then distills the pruned paths back, on the argument that CoT structure must match student capacity.
evidence.title: DRP: Distilled Reasoning Pruning with Mathematical Skill-aware Step Decomposition for Efficient Large Reasoning Models

evidence.note: Activations taken just before each explicit "Step k:" marker occupy linearly separable, step-indexed regions of representation space, and how a chain moves between those regions late in the trace predicts whether the final answer will be correct, which is used to gate interventions and to steer reasoning length.
evidence.title: LLM Reasoning as Trajectories: Step-Specific Representation Geometry and Correctness Signals

name: chain-of-thought distillation
